description: มุน 2026-08-06 (M-A + M-B): tapping a day selects it instead of navigating, and the calendar body has real states instead of `return null`. Two bug-classes are guarded. (1) DEAD SKELETON — goo's useCalendarMonth settles at {month: null, loading: false} for THREE branches (anon · user-row error · no birth date), so the obvious `if (!month) <Skeleton/>` pulses forever at anyone without a birth date; ตู๋ caught this exact shape on the home screen before (pages/v2/home-preview.tsx). The rule now lives in features/v2-calendar/components/calendar-view-state.ts where CI can prove that no settled input can render as 'loading' (scripts/calendar-view-state.test.ts, 2x2 input space ENUMERATED not sampled, teeth mut-skeleton-on-null · mut-empty-while-loading · mut-loading-wins, all three verified biting). (2) CARD-vs-HIGHLIGHT DISAGREEMENT — before M-B the grid highlight moved on tap while the card underneath kept describing today, and the CTA said 'ดูรายละเอียดวันนี้' regardless: one widget, two answers. The card and the CTA label now both follow selectedDate. Browser anchor harness/run-calendar-select.ts (25 checks) proves the states PAINT — a unit test cannot see a `hidden` class, a crash in the ready branch, or a skeleton rendered under the tier spinner; teeth mut-dead-skeleton · mut-card-today · mut-cell-link all verified biting. TWO defects were caught by LOOKING AT THE @393 RENDER, not by any anchor, and both were fixed: the settled-empty screen still drew a full grey calendar frame (a frame is itself a promise that days are coming), and the skeleton omitted the free-tier promo that the ready column renders, so the month landing pushed the whole page down — both states now share ONE container in pages/v2/calendar.tsx so they cannot drift apart geometrically. Anchors that keyed on the cell's href were repointed: harness/run-calendar-flow.ts now asserts the route that exists (tap does NOT navigate; the card CTA reaches the selected day) instead of the one that was removed, and its hardcoded '2026-07-15' is read from the grid instead. capture-daydetail-g2.ts was checked and left alone (DayStrip is still <Link>). gate_layer=behaviour/visual.
